service: discover public-Web source candidates for one customer-declared journalistic lead through bounded, witnessed search carriers
preconditions: the customer supplies one bounded lead title and optional public lead URL, publication instant, summary, and query hints
the demand fixes a ceiling of one to eight candidate citations

the provider may spend at most one Google Search-grounded inference request, one version-pinned Groq Compound Mini basic-search request with only one provider-executed Web Search tool enabled, and one keyless GDELT DOC request; no credential crosses from the customer
postconditions: candidate URLs and titles are constructed from provider-authored Google grounding metadata, Groq executed-tool search-result fields, or GDELT DOC article-list fields rather than parsed from model prose
people-finder, profile-directory, social-profile, encyclopedia, and bare contact-record results are refused before they can count toward a journalistic candidate floor
the delivery binds the exact demand, search carrier, queries, model or deterministic index route, provider-response digest, candidate list, instant, and resource account
every candidate remains unwarranted until the customer independently retrieves and admits it
quota exhaustion, unavailable credentials, carrier errors, and empty grounding are typed refusals
the provider writes no customer corpus or publication state
prohibitions: no model-authored URL extracted from prose or requested serialization
no inference of truth, source independence, license, or publication warrant from search rank, grounding, or index inclusion
no ambient publication assignment, retrieval, corpus admission, writing, editing, or release authority
no representation of an allocation request as zero-cost or external revenue

consideration.note: The provider records consumed Google, Groq Compound/Web Search, and GDELT carrier requests separately. Dollar cost remains unobserved until a provider billing receipt supplies it.
